context.p: An alternate clause can be inserted or swapped for any generated agreement document that contains the primary clause. All Alternate Clauses are visible and available from the Doc Clauses Tab under the Work Tab of the main Contracts Tab.

step.cmd: Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advaanced
Navigate to and check-out an agreement document you want to redline
Search for your primary clauses first. The alternate clause icon of two split arrows displays if there is an alternate clause available for a primary clause.
Click the three vertical dots beside the alternate clause icon
Click the down arrow for any of the alternate clauses listed to view the clause text and guidance
Click Replace to swap the standard clause with the alternate clause

ul.li: Make sure your Microsoft Word Font is the same as the clause you want to insert or your font will override the style of the clause

step.cmd: Click on the Doc Clause tab and verify that the alternate clause you selected is now in the current document clauses.
